description: Java class WidgetTypeDataValidator for validating WidgetTypeDetails objects, including name, descriptor, tenant ID, and FQN, with methods for data validation, creation, and update logic.

classes.name: WidgetTypeDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for WidgetTypeDetails objects, ensuring data integrity during create and update operations.

methods.name: validateDataImpl

methods.name: validateCreate

methods.description: Checks that the widget type is not moved to a different tenant and that the FQN is not changed.
